scenarios.title: Azure health check probe responds successfully
scenarios.when: a GET request is sent to /robots933456.txt
then: the response body is the plain text "OK"

scenarios.title: Azure health check probe succeeds when database is unavailable
given: the database is unreachable or disconnected
scenarios.when: a GET request is sent to /robots933456.txt
then: the health check probe succeeds without database dependency
the response body is the plain text "OK"

scenarios.title: Azure health check probe succeeds when event secrets are not configured
given: event secrets are absent or unconfigured
scenarios.when: a GET request is sent to /robots933456.txt
then: the health check probe succeeds without depending on event secrets
the response body is the plain text "OK"

scenarios.title: Azure health check probe succeeds regardless of application state
given: application state is uninitialized or in an error condition
scenarios.when: a GET request is sent to /robots933456.txt
then: the health check probe succeeds without depending on application state
the response body is the plain text "OK"

scenarios.title: Health check endpoint rejects unsupported HTTP request method
scenarios.when: a client submits an unsupported HTTP method (e.g. POST) to /robots933456.txt
then: the request does not succeed as a valid health check
